description: Microsoft App Center SDK (Crashes / Analytics; Unity plugin). The Unity integration auto-starts it from the AppCenterLoader ContentProvider (reads appcenter_app_secret / appcenter_startup_type / appcenter_use_crashes from res/values/strings.xml) and from C# through AppCenter.start/configure. Stubbing configure/start/startFromLibrary leaves the SDK unconfigured: its public getters (isEnabled, getInstallId, Crashes.*) return futures completed with the not-configured value and only log 'App Center hasn't been configured', so callers keep working. App Center itself was retired by Microsoft on 2025-03-31, but shipped apps still bundle and start it.

methods.name: configure
methods.note: void — configure(Application[, appSecret]): without it the SDK stays unconfigured

methods.name: start
methods.note: void varargs — start([Application,] [appSecret,] services...): starts Crashes/Analytics and log delivery to in.appcenter.ms

manifest_components.note: Unity plugin auto-start ContentProvider: onCreate() reads the app secret and startup type and calls AppCenter.configure/start before the game runs

detection.note: Verified on Bad Piggies HD 2.4.3379 (App Center 4.1.1, Crashes only).
